patch.description:
**Required scope:** `write`.

Categorise, hide or unhide, mark reviewed, or add and remove tags on many transactions in one request. Select them with `transactionIds`, or with `filter`, the filters of `GET /v1/account/transaction` (every matching row, hidden ones only with `includeHidden`). At most 5,000 transactions; a filter matching more is refused with `bulk_selection_too_large`. A filter key the list does not take is an error.
